All 57 `keep_attrs` tests pass.

The fix: instead of using a lambda that always returns `x`'s attrs (which overwrites coordinate attrs during coordinate merging), I changed `where()` to pass `keep_attrs="override"` to `apply_ufunc` (which correctly preserves each coordinate's own attrs), then manually set `result.attrs = getattr(x, "attrs", {})` afterward to apply `x`'s attrs to the result data variable. This preserves the #6461 scalar-x fix while no longer clobbering coordinate attributes.
